nodes.speaker: The Critic
nodes.text: It was always crooked. I told him so every night. Nobody should carry a crooked sword.
[i]You raise the lantern. In its light the blade on the anvil is bent near the tip, and it is the most beautiful thing in the room.[/i]

nodes.speaker: The Critic
nodes.text: She never once asked for it straight.
[i]The red ink lets go. It runs down the anvil and sinks into the floor like rain into a field.[/i]
